diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 4.5 V, datasheet reading 4.9 V
diffs.evidence: The part models the analog-output SEN0219, whose DFRobot product page specifies 'Operating Voltage: 4.5 ~ 5.5V DC' alongside 'Output Signal: Analog output (0.4 ~ 2V)'; the 4.9 V reading comes from the later PWM V2.0 spec 'Supply Voltage: DC (5.0±0.1)V', a different board variant.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.5 V, datasheet reading 5.1 V
diffs.evidence: For the analog-output SEN0219 that this part models, DFRobot's product page states 'Operating Voltage: 4.5 ~ 5.5V DC', while the 5.1 V reading is from the PWM V2.0 board's 'Supply Voltage: DC (5.0±0.1)V' spec, a different variant.
